nphi.title: FORTRESS-SSA – Outbreak resilience training for the sub-Saharan African public health workforce
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INS) Mozambique; National Health Laboratory Service (South Africa); Université d'Abomey-Calavi; LSHTM; UMC Utrecht; University of KwaZulu-Natal; Universidade Eduardo Mondlane; CIDRZ; Moi University
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 training project extending the SSACAB biostatistics consortium with master's training and short courses on modelling, surveillance and outbreak response for staff of public health institutes and ministries.

nphi.title: EACCR4 – Eastern Africa Consortium for Clinical Research 4
nphi.with: National Institute of Health of Somalia; National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Rwanda Biomedical Centre; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); University of Zambia; IAVI Africa; Infectious Diseases Institute; University of Copenhagen; LSHTM; Amsterdam UMC; Charité; University of Oslo; Karolinska Institutet; University of Oxford; BNITM; Université Catholique de Bukavu
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence led scientifically by Uganda's national health research organisation, expanding clinical research and outbreak research capacity across East Africa; partners include the national public…

nphi.title: LASR – Long-acting spatial repellents vs indoor residual spraying against malaria in western Kenya
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI, scientific lead); US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (partner); Radboudumc; ITM Antwerp
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 cluster-randomised trial in western Kenya comparing a spatial repellent with indoor residual spraying, led scientifically by KEMRI with US CDC as partner.

nphi.title: Kenya–Netherlands climate and health partnership
nphi.with: National Public Health Institute of Kenya; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); TNO; Kenyan Ministry of Health; Dutch Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
nphi.summary: Bilateral health-ministry partnership in which RIVM and Kenya's NPHI work on a climate change and health vulnerability and adaptation assessment. It also covers guidelines for green, climate-resilient healthcare facilities and knowledge…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P99 – Strengthening biosafety and biosecurity capabilities in East and Central Africa
nphi.with: Expertise France; SCJS Europe; University of Liège; ISEM Institute
nphi.summary: RIVM leads the national biorisk assessment and biorisk-management work packages and co-leads dual-use research oversight in a One Health biosecurity project.

nphi.title: Heat and air pollution exposure model for Kenya
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) and its Air Pollution Centre of Excellence; Clean Air Africa Center; funded by the Dutch Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
nphi.summary: Prototype that maps heat stress and air pollution exposure for vulnerable groups across Kenyan regions; selected by the WHO-hosted ATACH platform as a case study and presented at COP29.

nphi.title: EACCR2 – Eastern Africa Consortium for Clinical Research 2
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); Addis Ababa University; Karolinska Institutet; ITM Antwerp; AIGHD; Radboudumc; University of Oxford; UCL; KCMC; University of Khartoum; University of Rwanda
nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence coordinated by Uganda's national health research organisation to strengthen clinical trial and research capacity across Eastern Africa. Tanzania's NIMR and KEMRI were partners alongside European…

nphi.title: Biosecurity and national dangerous-pathogen inventories in East Africa (incl. lessons learned)
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinated biosafety and biosecurity work, gave four East African countries a pathogen-inventory tool, and is now compiling lessons learned.

nphi.title: VaccTrain Next – Regulatory oversight of clinical trials of vaccines and biologicals
nphi.with: Food and Drugs Authority (Ghana); Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; National Drug Authority (Uganda); Pharmacy and Poisons Board (Kenya); Botswana Medicines Regulatory Authority; Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority; Egyptian Drug Authority; AUDA-NEPAD (AVAREF, AU-3S); WHO AFRO; CEPI (Norway)
nphi.summary: Strengthens African regulators' scientific and regulatory capacity to oversee clinical trials of vaccines and biologicals, including for emergency settings.

nphi.title: PharmTrain3 – Regulatory capacities for marketing authorisation of medicinal products
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: AUDA-NEPAD; Egyptian Drug Authority; Food and Drugs Authority (Ghana); Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority; Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; NAFDAC (Nigeria); National Drug Authority (Uganda); Pharmacy and Poisons Board (Kenya); SADC-MRH Secretariat; SAHPRA (South Africa); TMDA (Tanzania); WHO; Paul-Ehrlich-Institut (Germany)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer strengthening of African medicines regulators in assessing marketing authorisation applications, focusing on clinical assessment and biologicals/biosimilars.

nphi.title: EAVI – European-African Vaccine Initiative against chikungunya in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII); Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI, trial sponsor); Ifakara Health Institute (scientific lead); Valneva Austria; EPFL; Karolinska Institutet
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 partnership running a phase IIIb chikungunya vaccine trial in Kenya and Tanzania and preparing master protocols for future NTD vaccine trials; Spain's ISCIII and KEMRI participate.

nphi.title: SINCEP-Africa – Institutional networks and capacity for epidemiological preparedness in Africa
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire; Ghana Health Service; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; PANDORA platform (France); Fundação Manhiça; Ifakara Health Institute; Makerere University; Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Universidad de Navarra; CTI Africa
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 coordination action turning INDEPTH community-based health surveillance sites into trial-ready sites for outbreaks, with Côte d'Ivoire's INSP hosting a new site.

nphi.title: ANTENNA – Training hubs for statisticians and epidemiologists in Eastern, Central and Western Africa
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Pública (INASA) Guinea-Bissau; Senegal Ministry of Health and Social Action; Hôpital Général de Douala; CRID Cameroon; University of Buea; RARS; UCAD; Joint Clinical Research Centre; Instituto Piaget; Universidade Nova de Lisboa; LSHTM; Universidade de Cabo Verde
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project creating cross-regional training hubs for epidemiology and biostatistics fellows in Cameroon, Senegal and Guinea-Bissau, with Guinea-Bissau's national public health institute INASA as a beneficiary.

nphi.title: AFRITRAC – African Training Network for Biostatistics, Epidemiology and Infectious Disease Modelling
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burundi; Africa CDC (partner); Université de Yaoundé I; USTTB Bamako; University of St Andrews; Makerere University; APHRC; University of Cape Coast; CERMEL; Mbarara University; Université Catholique de Bukavu
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network training 35 early-career professionals through a harmonised master's programme and regional hub, with Tanzania's NIMR, Burundi's INSP and Africa CDC involved.

nphi.title: MUKET Consortium – AI-enabled early warning for arboviral diseases
nphi.with: Africa CDC; Ethiopian Ministry of Health; national partners in the five MUKET countries
nphi.summary: Five-country consortium led by EPHI, inaugurated in September 2026, linking human, animal, vector, genomic, climate and environmental data with AI/GIS to forecast arboviral disease risk and strengthen laboratory and genomic capacity.

nphi.title: VectorGrid-Africa – Network of permanent observatories for mosquitoes and mosquito-borne diseases
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur de Madagascar; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); Ifakara Health Institute (scientific lead); Fundação Manhiça; Wits Health Consortium; University of Nairobi; Technical University of Kenya; Universidade Eduardo Mondlane; Genome Research Ltd (Wellcome Sanger)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project building a pan-African platform for standardised mosquito surveillance data, piloted in five East and Southern African countries, with Institut Pasteur de Madagascar and KEMRI among partners.

nphi.title: KEMRI–Wellcome–Oxford partnership renewal (GBP 91 million)
nphi.with: Wellcome; University of Oxford (Nuffield Department of Medicine)
nphi.summary: Seven-year agreement signed in March 2025 renewing the KEMRI-Wellcome Trust Research Programme with up to GBP 91 million for research and training on malaria, pneumonia, meningitis, HIV, nutrition and vaccines.

nphi.title: BRIDGE Network – African-European training network in integrated health informatics and data sciences
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Ghent University (coordinator); Uganda Ministry of Health; University of Cape Town; Mountains of the Moon University; IRSP Ouidah; Aga Khan University Kenya; EdenceHealth; Medical Data Management
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network led scientifically by the Rwanda Biomedical Centre, with Norway's NIPH and Ethiopia's EPHI, setting up five African centres of excellence training researchers to use health data for infectious disease research.

nphi.title: BRIDGE Network – Building Africa's future in health data and infectious disease research
nphi.with: Ghent University (coordinator); Centres of Excellence in Benin, Ethiopia, Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa
nphi.summary: EDCTP3-funded network linking African centres of excellence and European partners; NIPH co-leads data harmonisation, data-sharing ethics and communication.

nphi.title: KEMRI – US CDC five-year MoU renewal (2024)
nphi.with: US CDC
nphi.summary: Renewed MoU for reciprocal research, laboratory leadership, outbreak response, staff exchange and policy-relevant public health research.

nphi.title: JICA grant: Strengthening the research capacity of KEMRI
nphi.with: JICA
nphi.summary: Japanese grant aid of up to 3,056 million yen for research complexes and equipment to boost infectious disease research and early diagnosis in Kenya and East Africa.

nphi.title: GenPath Africa – Genomic surveillance of drug-resistant TB, HIV and Rift Valley fever
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INS) Mozambique; International Livestock Research Institute; University of Antwerp; LINQ Management
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project expanding pathogen genomic surveillance in Southern and Eastern Africa for drug-resistant TB, HIV and Rift Valley fever virus, with Mozambique's INS as a partner.

nphi.title: SATREPS: schistosomiasis control and elimination in Kenya
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); Maseno University
nphi.summary: Nagasaki University SATREPS project with KEMRI and Maseno University on schistosomiasis control and elimination.

nphi.title: Africa CDC Eastern Africa Regional Coordination Centre (Nairobi)
nphi.with: Kenya Ministry of Health (host)
nphi.summary: RCC hosted by Kenya's MoH, launched 1 Oct 2021, coordinating Africa CDC activity and outbreak response across Eastern Africa.

nphi.title: Nagasaki University Kenya Research Station at KEMRI
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI)
nphi.summary: Nagasaki University's overseas research station based at KEMRI in Nairobi since 2005, hosting joint research (SATREPS, AMED), training and a BSL-3 facility covered by a 2024 agreement with KEMRI.

nphi.title: Nagasaki University – KEMRI MoU (since 2004, renewed 2023)
nphi.with: Nagasaki University
nphi.summary: Long-running research and human-resource partnership, renewed for the fourth time in July 2023.

nphi.title: East African Integrated Disease Surveillance Network (EAIDSNet)
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania (where EAIDSNet started in 2000); EAC Partner State ministries of human and animal health; national health research institutions; Rockefeller Foundation
nphi.summary: One Health cross-border disease surveillance network of EAC Partner States, started as a project at Tanzania's NIMR in 2000 and revitalised at a 2023 meeting in Kigali.

nphi.title: CDC Kenya country office – MOH and KEMRI collaboration
nphi.with: Kenya Ministry of Health; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI)
nphi.summary: CDC has had an office in Kenya since 1979, co-running a malaria research field station with KEMRI, supporting KEMRI and national/county laboratories (incl. genomic sequencing), the multi-level FELTP and PEPFAR HIV/TB work.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Kenya – Phase 2
nphi.with: National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL, hosts Fund-supported national AMR surveillance dashboard); Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: ILRI leads Kenya's phase 2 Fleming Fund grant, which supports the national AMR surveillance dashboard hosted by the National Public Health Laboratory.

nphi.title: RKI–Africa CDC side events at CPHIA 2023 (Lusaka)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; WHO AFRO and EMRO
nphi.summary: Two side events at the 2023 International Conference on Public Health in Africa presented joint epidemic-intelligence work under HSPA and launched an Africa CDC continental guidance framework for NCD, injury and mental-health surveillance…

nphi.title: UNIPH peer exchange with Kenya and Rwanda on border health risk mapping
nphi.actor: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH)
nphi.summary: In 2022, with IANPHI/US CDC support for border health, UNIPH worked with Kenya and Rwanda on peer-to-peer training and exchange on health risk mapping.

nphi.title: New Variant Assessment Platform (NVAP) – international genomic surveillance partnerships
nphi.with: National partners in nine countries/territories; WHO EMRO sequencing hubs (Oman, Abu Dhabi, Morocco); Africa CDC; CARPHA
nphi.summary: Set up by PHE in 2021 and continued by UKHSA, NVAP provides sequencing reagents, training in bioinformatics and variant risk assessment, and scientific exchanges to partner countries and regional bodies.

nphi.title: ENTRANT – East and Southern African Consortium for Outbreak Epidemiology Training
nphi.actor: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); National Health Laboratory Botswana; University of Nairobi; ZAMBART; Haramaya University; Mwanza Intervention Trials Unit; Ministry of Health and Child Care Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: EDCTP2/Africa CDC-funded consortium offering master's-level outbreak epidemiology training in East and Southern Africa, with UVRI among the African partners.

nphi.title: One Health and vector-borne/zoonotic surveillance support to INS Mozambique
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INS) Mozambique; Kenyan One Health experts
nphi.summary: In 2020, IANPHI's Mozambique project built INS capacity in vector-borne and zoonotic surveillance and One Health. The Oswaldo Cruz Institute (Brazil) and Kenyan One Health experts were collaborators.

nphi.title: CDC and IANPHI support for establishing the Kenya National Public Health Institute
nphi.with: Kenya National Public Health Institute (KNPHI); Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: CDC sponsored a 2020 Nairobi planning workshop with IANPHI and hosted a Kenyan delegation in 2024 ahead of KNPHI's operational launch in May 2025, which took over the PHEOC, surveillance, port health and FELTP from the ministry.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Kenya – Phase 1
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); International Livestock Research Institute (ILRI); University of Nairobi; Aga Khan University; Washington State University; National Public Health Laboratory (NPHL)
nphi.summary: PATH led Kenya's first Fleming Fund country grant (2019) within a six-institution consortium including KEMRI and ILRI, building active and passive AMR surveillance and lab capacity across human and animal health.

nphi.title: NIHE – ILRI memorandum of agreement on One Health research
nphi.actor: National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology (NIHE)
nphi.with: International Livestock Research Institute (ILRI)
nphi.summary: Agreement formalising long-standing NIHE–ILRI collaboration on zoonoses, AMR, communicable diseases and capacity development in Vietnam.

nphi.title: PREPARE – Partnership for Building Resilience against Public Health Emergencies through Advanced Research and Education
nphi.with: INRB (DRC), ZNPHI (Zambia), NMIMR (Ghana), KEMRI (Kenya), Suez Canal University (Egypt) and other core laboratories
nphi.summary: JICA programme linking core infectious disease laboratories in Africa and Asia, including JICA-funded BSL-3 facilities at DRC's INRB, regional surveillance training at ZNPHI and long-term training run with Nagasaki and Hokkaido…

nphi.title: Kenya–Canada peer-to-peer partnership
nphi.with: Kenya Ministry of Health (DPPHS); IANPHI
nphi.summary: PHAC hosted a study tour for Kenya's new Directorate of Preventive and Promotive Health Services on how a national public health agency is set up.

nphi.title: IANPHI Leadership Academy for African NPHI leaders
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde (INS) Mozambique; National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania
nphi.summary: IANPHI launched a Leadership Academy in 2014 with backing from Sweden's NPHI and the Gates Foundation. INS Mozambique and NIMR Tanzania gave local support, and a Kenyan participant went on to become a Heymann Fellow.

nphi.title: ACILT laboratory training and the Labs for Life partnership
nphi.actor: National Health Laboratory Service (NHLS) – African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training (ACILT)
nphi.with: CDC South Africa; PEPFAR; Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD)
nphi.summary: NHLS's African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training, supported by CDC, provides hands-on training and mentoring to laboratory staff from partner countries, including under the PEPFAR/CDC–BD Labs for Life public-private partnership…

nphi.title: SATREPS: rapid diagnostics and alert system for yellow fever and Rift Valley fever in Kenya
nphi.with: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI)
nphi.summary: Nagasaki University SATREPS project with KEMRI developing rapid diagnostics and an outbreak alert system for yellow fever and Rift Valley fever.

nphi.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) sites
nphi.with: icddr,b (Bangladesh); Egyptian MoHP and NAMRU-3; GDD Regional Centre partners in China, Guatemala, Kenya and Thailand
nphi.summary: CDC's International Emerging Infections Program ran population-based surveillance and research on emerging infections at six sites, mostly within the GDD Regional Centers, with a Bangladesh site formalised with icddr,b in 2009.

nphi.title: International Infectious Disease Centre, Nairobi (NML contribution)
nphi.with: University of Nairobi; University of Manitoba; National Microbiology Laboratory (NML)
nphi.summary: PHAC's National Microbiology Laboratory gave expertise and equipment to the International Infectious Disease Centre in Nairobi, which opened in 2007 from the University of Manitoba–University of Nairobi partnership to support infectious…

nphi.title: Global Disease Detection (GDD) Regional Centers network
nphi.with: Host ministries of health / national public health institutes (not named on source page)
nphi.summary: CDC set up ten GDD Regional Centers between 2004 and 2013, working with host governments on outbreak detection and response, laboratory capacity, field epidemiology training and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: Kenya biosecurity and biopreparedness partnership
nphi.with: Centre for Biosecurity and Biopreparedness (SSI); Kenyan agencies and life-science universities
nphi.summary: A six-year partnership programme that helped Kenya draft and implement biosecurity legislation. It also built biopreparedness capacity in agencies and raised awareness at universities.
